field.name: icon
field.comment: The class names of the Font Awesome icon displayed above the title, for instance fas fa-address-book (it's ignored when fID is set)

field.name: paragraph
field.comment: The rich text displayed below the title

field.name: externalLink
field.comment: The URL the feature links to (used if internalLinkCID is 0)

field.name: internalLinkCID
field.comment: The ID of the page the feature links to (0 or NULL: it links to externalLink, if that one is filled)

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the title: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p

field.name: fID
field.comment: The ID of the image displayed above the title, which replaces the icon (0 or NULL: none)
